cpu.desc: CPU allocation in threads. 100% = 1 thread, 200% = 2 threads

disk.desc: Disk space allocation in MB (30720 MB = 30 GB)

memory.desc: How much memory in MB to allocate

ip.desc: What IP to bind the server to

queryport.desc: Steam query port (UDP), used by the server browser

rconport.desc: RCON port (TCP), only used when an RCON password is set

servername.desc: Name shown in the server browser

serverpassword.desc: Password players need to join. Empty means anyone can join. No spaces or question marks

map.desc: Map loaded at startup, for example Oilfield, Farmhouse or Hideout

scenario.desc: Scenario for that map, for example Scenario_Refinery_Push_Security or Scenario_Farmhouse_Checkpoint_Security

rconpassword.desc: Password for RCON tools. Empty turns RCON off

gslt.desc: Steam game server login token (App ID 581320), from steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers. Needed to show up in the server browser

commands: bash -c "for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do steamcmd +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux +force_install_dir /SkyPanel +login anonymous +app_update 581330 validate +quit && exit 0; echo 'steamcmd could not finish the download, trying again in 15s ($try/5)'; sleep 15; done; exit 1"

bash -c "mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64; for d in .steam .steam/steamcmd .local/share/Steam/steamcmd steamcmd; do if [ -f $d/linux32/steamclient.so ]; then cp -f $d/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/; fi; if [ -f $d/linux64/steamclient.so ]; then cp -f $d/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/; fi; done; true"

command.command: bash -c "if [ \"$(id -u)\" = 0 ] && id container >/dev/null 2>&1; then chown -R container:container . && exec setpriv --reuid=container --regid=container --init-groups env HOME=\"$PWD\" \"$@\"; fi; exec \"$@\"" aether ./Insurgency/Binaries/Linux/InsurgencyServer-Linux-Shipping ${map}?Scenario=${scenario}?MaxPlayers=${maxplayers}?Password=${serverpassword} -Port=${port} -QueryPort=${queryport} -hostname="${servername}" -Rcon -RconPassword="${rconpassword}" -RconListenPort=${rconport} -GSLTToken=${gslt} -log
